name: ODDO BHF EUROD
oneLiner: EUROD is ODDO BHF SCA's euro token, redeemable at par as an unsecured claim on the bank's general balance sheet.
collateral: ODDO BHF SCA’s full bank balance sheet; received funds form general bank assets rather than a segregated EMI reserve. Current underlying asset weights are undisclosed.
pegMechanism: A euro-denominated claim redeemable at par with ODDO BHF SCA after eligibility and AML checks; holders are unsecured creditors rather than beneficiaries of a segregated EMI reserve.
launchPhaseDetail: Publicly issued on Polygon; Pharos has no admitted price lane.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: exact-contract CoinGecko and DefiLlama quotes and DexScreener pools were unavailable on review. Positive Polygon issuance is verified.

proofOfReserves.provider: ODDO BHF SCA issuer figures; no independently reconciled token reserve report retrieved

milestones.title: EUROD launches on Polygon
milestones.description: ODDO BHF announces EUROD for clients and distribution partners, including Bit2Me.
